facts.value: Urban design is the process of designing and shaping the physical features of cities, towns, and villages.

In contrast to architecture, which focuses on the design of individual buildings, urban design deals with the larger scale of groups of buildings, streets and public spaces, whole neighborhoods and districts, and entire cities.
The goal of urban design is to make urban areas functional, attractive, and sustainable.
Urban design is an interdisciplinary field that uses elements of many built environment professions.
Urban design includes elements from landscape architecture, urban planning, architecture, civil engineering, and municipal engineering.
Different subfields of urban design include strategic urban design, landscape urbanism, water-sensitive urban design, and sustainable urbanism.
